notes.title: Karate Survivor is out now!
notes.content:
Are you ready to unleash your inner martial arts master? Karate Survivor is live, ready to throw you into the gritty, fast-paced world of 80s street brawls! 

In this survivor-like roguelite, every corner of the city is your battleground. Fend off relentless thugs using fists, feet, and anything you can get your hands on – from mop handles to plastic flamingos! Your surroundings are part of your arsenal. Push over scaffolding, swing microwave doors, and turn the world into a weapon. 

[previewyoutube=WH_KjiLuvMg;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What awaits you in Karate Survivor: [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Improvised Combat:[/b] Use whatever you can get your hands on to dismantle your enemies. Even a toy hammer can be lethal! 
[*][b] Environmental Warfare: [/b]Manipulate the streets to your advantage. Push objects at enemies, bring down scaffolding, or slam them with a microwave door. 
[*] [b]Dynamic Combos: [/b]Mix and match dozens of attacks into unique six-move combos. Find the most devastating combos to suit your style. 
[*] [b]Progression and Mastery: [/b]Unlock and master techniques that stay with you across runs. Every fight brings you closer to martial arts mastery. 
[*] [b]Fast-paced Runs and Boss Battles: [/b]Face fierce bosses across gritty locations in epic, high-speed showdowns. 
[/list]
Also, we’ll be adding a new challenge mode as a New Game+ with increased difficulty in an upcoming post-release patch for those eager to test their skills. 

Stay tuned and grab Karate Survivor now with a 10% launch discount. Don’t forget to leave a review to support us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027930/Karate_Survivor/

notes.title: Update 1.3.7 with a new mode
notes.content:
We’re excited to roll out the Necroking update with a new game mode and several improvements. Please ensure you have the latest version (1.3.7) of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897194/5cd184fcad369dd0082d890b32b8d270190528c9.jpg[/img]

[b]List of Changes: [/b]

[list]
[*] Added a new ‘Strategy’ mode. In this mode, most cards added to your deck will burn away permanently after each battle, and you’ll need to rebuild your deck from your reserves after every fight. You must manage your deck carefully to make it through the entire run. The mode unlocks after defeating the final form of the King. 
[*] Added 4 new achievements.  
[*] Changed controls for gamepad/Steam Deck during battles. Instead of holding a button for several seconds to draw cards, you now just double-tap the same button. 
[*] Made some minor UI improvements. 
[/list]
Thanks for playing Necroking! Enjoy the new mode, and keep the feedback coming! Stay tuned for more updates.

notes.title: Small Content Update 1.1.2
notes.content:
We’re excited to bring you an update with important improvements to save files and exciting new content! Please ensure you have the latest version (1.1.2) of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897194/18703961d56520957de15032ad5004446ee3f310.jpg[/img]

[b]List of Changes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new mini-biome. The new biome features fresh tiles, including wave-based enemy battles and a new boss tile. It has a 50% chance of replacing the Mushroom biome. 
[*] Added new units: Gunner, Walking Coffin, Burning Skull. 
[*] Changed the save system. We’ve updated the save file location to fix issues with OneDrive and other cloud services. The new save directory is now located at: [i]AppData/LocalLow/KORO GAMES/Necroking[/i] instead of the old location [i]Documents/KORO GAMES/Necroking[/i]. 
The transfer happens automatically. If you use Steam Cloud, please select the latest local save after the transfer. Also, the game now automatically creates backup saves when you enter battle or the main menu. 
[/list]
Thanks for playing Necroking! Enjoy the new content, share your thoughts, and stay tuned for future updates! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852980/Necroking/

notes.title: Major Balance Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
We’re exited to release another patch for Necroking, focused on addressing bugs and making key balance adjustments. Please ensure you have the latest version (1.0.5) of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897194/cdccac4bb81ce93ba88e445f1bada555351e0ad8.jpg[/img]

[b]List of balance changes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the difficulty of the King. 
[*] Increased the chance of Mound (meta shop) appearing on the map. 
[*] Reduced the percentage of lost units when fleeing. 
[*] Cultist: Maximum strength reduced from 10 to 7; Rune cost increased from 1 to 4. 
[*] Rider: Strength set to 5; a new ability grants +2 strength when moving forward and –2 strength when moving backward. 
[*] Vampire: Strength reduced from 9 to 8, soul cost increased from 6 to 7. 
[*] Scapegoat: Mana cost increased from 2 to 6; added a new ability that makes it a priority target for attacks. 
[*] Spider Priest: Card draw per turn increased from +1 to +3. 
[*] Cocoon: Gained a reusable ability. 
[*] Spider Prince: Gained an attack ability. 
[*] Slingshot Skeleton: Strength reduced from 2 to 1; now gains a movement ability, allowing it to move to the next zone if there are no enemies in either its current zone or the next one. 
[*] Wizard: Strength reduced from 8 to 7. 
[*] Healer: Mana cost reduced from 10 to 7; soul cost reduced from 2 to 1. 
[*] Summoner: Mana cost reduced from 10 to 7. 
[*] Swamp Spirit: Starting mana cost increased from 20 to 40. 
[*] Soul Thief: Treasure cost increased from 140 to 160; crafting recipe changed to “Swordsman + Restless Ghost + Soul Orb” (was “Swordsman + Soul Orb”). 
[*] Summoner Mage: Strength increased from 2 to 8. 
[*] Demon: Strength gained from Soul Totem increased from +1 to +2; maximum boost reduced from 15 to 14; spawn zones expanded from 1 and 2 to 1, 2, and 3. 
[*] Soul Totem: Strength increased from 1 to 5; soul cost reduced from 2 to 1; spawn zones adjusted from 1, 2, 3, and 4 to 1, 2, and 3. 
[*] Soul Bomb: Damage increased from 3 to 5. 
[/list]
[b]Other changes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the dialogue window freezing after completing quests. 
[*] Removed some unused settings from the game. 
[/list]
Thanks for playing Necroking! More updates are on the way, leave feedback and stay tuned. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852980/Necroking/

notes.title: First Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
We’re excited to bring you the first patch for Necroking, focused on balancing gameplay and enhancing the overall player experience. Please ensure you have the latest version (1.0.4) of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897194/6d677cc0332c9ea52246bd1d895a20dd42f30fe5.jpg[/img]

[b]List of changes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Increased starting bones from 14 to 20 in expedition mode and from 12 to 15 in balanced mode. 
[*] Improved targeting logic for ranged units. They now have the same attack priority as melee units. 
[*] Improved the deckbuilding tutorial. 
[*] Changed the Mad Scientist’s behavior. He no longer has the skill that makes him the last to be attacked and will now actively protect his creations in combat. 
[*] Changed the text when starting a new run. It no longer incorrectly mentions save loss and now accurately reflects the intended meaning. 
[*] Added a new visual and text notification when the player lacks supplies for an escape attempt. 
[*] Added new VFX to indicate when the player doesn’t have enough cards for battle. 
[*] Fixed an issue with infinite loading in the game. 
[*] Fixed an issue with battles hanging. 
[*] Fixed misspellings in tooltips. 
[/list]
[b]We also want to share our plans for future updates: [/b]
[list]
[*] Bug fixes and both major and minor improvements. 
[*] Controller support (PS, Xbox, Nintendo). 
[*] Steam Deck verification. We plan to receive full Steam Deck full compatibility check mark after adding controller support. For now, you can play Necroking on Steam Deck using the trackpads. 
[*] New mini-biome and units. 
[*] New Game+ mode. 
[/list]
Thank you for your feedback and support as we continue to improve Necroking! Stay tuned for more updates and exciting content coming soon. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852980/Necroking

notes.title: Necroking is now available!
notes.content:
The wait is over – Necroking has officially emerged from the shadows and is now live on Windows and macOS! 

The world is crumbling under chaos. Cities are rotting and the living dare to stand in your way. But fear not, because you are the Necroking – master of the undead, wielder of dark magic, and bringer of doom. It’s time to raise your army and show the world what real power looks like! 

[previewyoutube=mZ1W5iGz0MU;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What awaits you in Necroking:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Become the Death Monarch.[/b] Command over 30 unique undead minions and crush anyone who stands against you. 
[*] [b]Vast Skull Deckbuilding. [/b]Customize your deck, unlock powerful units, and devastate your enemies. 
[*] [b]4 diverse biomes.[/b] Each with its own deadly challenges and unique bosses. 
[*] [b]King’s Secret. [/b]Unravel the mystery of the King as you journey through a dark, twisted story. 
[/list]
You can already play Necroking on Steam Deck using the trackpads, and we’re hard at work on adding full controller and Steam Deck support in upcoming updates. Stay tuned and join our [url=https://discord.gg/alawar]Discord[/url] server to keep up with all the news!

Get the game with a 10% launch discount and leave feedback on Necroking – we can’t wait to hear what you think: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852980/Necroking/

notes.title: Playtest results and plans
notes.content:
The playtest for Necroking has come to an end, and it's time to share the results. 

First and foremost, we'd like to thank everyone who played our game and actively shared feedback on Steam, our Discord server, and through the in-game survey. We truly appreciate your patience, interest in the project, and the ideas you've shared with us! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897194/dccf6ff9d167e0553c874f375db25c1e7944bdbd.jpg[/img]

We've carefully reviewed all the feedback and suggestions and are ready to share the upcoming changes we've started implementing: 

[list]
[*] New biomes added: Spider, Swamp, and Demonic. Defeat the king and unlock new territories! 
[*] Updated the interface and gameplay after death to make starting a new game easier. Now, players respawn at the beginning of the map after defeat and can choose cards after dying. 
[*] Added new cards that combine two units and have a reduced cost. 
[*] Introduced additional ways to obtain souls. 
[*] Added new points of interest on the map. 
[*] Improved and redesigned the Obelisk interface, including a new recipe book. 
[*] Enhanced the Forest Spirit's window interface. 
[*] Added captions to the deck interface during battles. 
[*] Included a special comic that will be available after defeating the king, revealing more of the game's story. 
[/list]
We continue to work on adding new content and improving features. You can try out these updates next month when the Necroking demo becomes part of the upcoming [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]! 

To stay updated on all the news and follow our development process, make sure Necroking is on your wishlist! Additionally, join our [url=https://discord.gg/alawar]Discord[/url] server to connect with other fans!
